newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse to start automated trading.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse to start automated trading.

text.p: Pakistan's main Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) will begin automated trading on August 14 to handle 40,000 transactions daily compared to some 20,000 at present, KSE president Arif Habib said on Friday .

By September, the KSE's Karachi Automated Trading System (KATS), which was set up with the help of a Canadian firm, would be fully automated and handle trading and settlement, Habib said in a statement.
"The KATS will introduce transparancy," Habib said.
